answer: Each identity must purchase its standing with a sealed deposit that expires unless renewed by audited work. A newcomer clears thirty-two audited jobs, locks 210 units for two epochs, and wins four vouches from veteran peers whose records never overlap. A clone reruns every job and posts fresh collateral, and a disproved job forfeits it entirely. Since receipts cannot recur and vouchers cannot be shared, inherited credibility is empty, so every extra puppet costs far more than the influence it can ever earn. reef ferrous violet
